subject: Private deployment staging sanity + account boarding checklist
messages:
From: Sam Patel <sam.patel@nexera.com>
To: alex_martinez@redwood.com
Cc: infra@nexera.com
Date: Mon, 30 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Private deployment intake — staging run and network checks

Hi Alex,

Thanks again for the walkthrough yesterday. As we get closer to provisioning the staging VPC (+ on-prem connector), infra asked for a compact checklist we can use to validate the environment before we cut traffic. Can you share a concise runbook of the minimal gating items (network, certs, service accounts, egress rules) so our ops team can tick things off during the week of Dec 13?

We're targeting a brief smoke test window on Dec 15 between 14:00–16:00 PST. Please include any specific test tokens, sample payloads, and fallbacks if the primary model pool is unavailable.

Cheers,
Sam
Sam Patel
Head of Platform Engineering — Nexera
From: alex_martinez@redwood.com
To: Sam Patel <sam.patel@nexera.com>
Cc: kimberly_park@redwood.com, jonas_weber@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 30 Nov 2026 11:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Private deployment intake — staging run and network checks

Sam,

Appreciate the clear window. I've attached a condensed staging-sanity spreadsheet (redwood-privdeploy-staging-sanity-v1.xlsx) that our onboarding engineers use for day-0 validation — prioritized so the ops team can run through it in ~45–60 minutes. High-level highlights below: 

- Network: verify BGP/peer or VPN tunnel, allowed egress CIDR to Redwood regional endpoints, DNS resolution for token endpoints.
- Auth: service account + key rotation check, scoped IAM roles, and KMS/HSM connectivity test.
- TLS/Certs: client certs for mutual TLS (if enabled) and root CA presence on host.
- Connectivity: sample gRPC and REST end-to-end payloads (2x small/1x large), expected latency baselines.
- KV cache & persistence: sanity read/write for prefix cache and S3/Blob persistence if used.
- Fallbacks: policy to failover to hosted-compatible variant + assertion points so you can detect fallback.

I've also attached an annotated network diagram from your team (nexera-network-diagram-annotated.png) and placed a DocuSign MPA for countersign (nexera-mpa-signature-request.pdf).

Action items for the Dec 15 smoke window: 
1) Nexera ops: confirm tunnel health and egress allowlist by Dec 10.
2) Redwood: provision staging tokens and a canary model bundle by Dec 13 EOD.
3) Joint: run the spreadsheet checks during the 14:00–16:00 window and capture traces in the shared Drive link.

I'll be available during the window; Kim (network lead) and Jonas (runtime) are copied for any infra / kernel questions. If you'd like we can reduce the checklist to a one-pager for the ops war room — say 8 lines that must pass.

Best,
Alex Martinez
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
From: kimberly_park@redwood.com
To: alex_martinez@redwood.com
Cc: jonas_weber@redwood.com, Sam Patel <sam.patel@nexera.com>
Date: Tue, 01 Dec 2026 08:27:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Private deployment intake — staging run and network checks

Quick notes from the runtime perspective — adding these to the checklist guidance: 

- Kernel/quantization variant: Ensure the staging pool is pinned to the quantized runtime we agreed on (q8_2). Mismatch will blow up latency baselines.
- KV cache seed: run a small prefix load (10k tokens) before the smoke test to prime caches for realistic latency.
- Batch sizing: send a mix of single-stream and batched concurrent requests (1x1 and 4xparallel) to validate autoscaling triggers.
- Trace IDs: include X-Redwood-Trace headers in test requests so we can link logs to traces in Console.

I'll drop a minimal one-page ops checklist into the Drive link later today. Jon, can you confirm the fallback model bundle will be ready by Dec 13?

-Kim
Kimberly Park
Network & Onboarding Lead | Redwood Inference
From: jonas_weber@redwood.com
To: kimberly_park@redwood.com, alex_martinez@redwood.com
Cc: Sam Patel <sam.patel@nexera.com>
Date: Tue, 15 Dec 2026 15:04:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Private deployment intake — staging run and network checks

All set — performed the canary deploy earlier this morning and validated: 
- Canary model bundle (q8_2 variant) deployed to the staging pool at 09:10 PST.
- Staging tokens issued: token-stg-nexera-001 (valid until 2027-01-15).
- Fallback bundle (hosted-compatible small model) is registered and will auto-fallback on capacity warnings.
- I uploaded short sample payloads and a smoke-run script to the Drive link.

Sam — if you kick off the 14:00 run now we should see the KV seed latency and autoscaling behavior captured. Ping me on Slack for any trace lookups.

Thanks,
Jonas Weber
Runtime Engineer | Redwood Inference
